reason: I'm always hunting for somewhere indoors to go with the baby, and the zoo only works when the weather does. A gated Baby Nook and a cap on how many kids are in at once is what I'd want, so I'd use the free visit and probably come back a couple of times.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Five-year-olds in the same room as an 8-month-old worries me, even with a Baby Nook, and I'd pay $13 a visit only if it really stays calm.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in person that the Baby Nook is truly separate and staffed, and that the kid limit is enforced on weekday mornings.
